name: ai-answer-rank
description: Is your brand in the AI answer? A question types into a chat card, the assistant answers with a ranked list of three picks, then re-ranks: the promoted brand slides into its slot, the picks below step down, and the brand row lands with the one accent highlight and a check. For answer-engine and AI-visibility marketing

vars.description: The question typed into the user bubble. Up to about 60 characters keeps it on one or two lines.
The assistant line above the ranked list.
First pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.
Second pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.
Third pick in the original answer. It drops out of the top three when the brand lands.
The brand this video promotes, by its real name. It slides into the answer and takes the highlight.
The slot the brand lands in. Picks at and below it step down one place.
Highlight, monogram and check on the brand row, the one accent element.
Text colour; every placeholder surface is this ink at an alpha step.
Chat card surface; the page around it is the ground tinted toward the ink.
